format: New Hardee's Restaurant at a Traditional Location in an approximately 2,200 square foot freestanding building with 24 seats and drive-thru, excluding land/real property

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin the operation of a newly-developed Hardee's Restaurant ranges from approximately $1,385,000 to $2,637,395. This includes $57,000 to $97,000, which must be paid to us. The total investment range does not include the cost of buying or renting the business location.

fee.quote: The Initial Franchise Fee is $25,000, although the balance of the Initial Franchise Fee is reduced to $15,000 for a Restaurant developed pursuant to the terms of a Development Agreement.
fee.note: Under a Development Agreement a $10,000 non-refundable Development Fee per restaurant is credited against the fee (balance $15,000). If buying an existing company-operated restaurant, the fee is included in the negotiated purchase price. Opening Training Support Fee estimated $32,000 to $70,000 in Item 5 ($32,000 to $72,000 in Item 7). Additional FMTP trainees $500 per person per week. HR may waive the fee as an incentive; in 2026 it waived it for some takeovers of closed restaurants.

royalty.quote: Royalty 4% of Gross Sales (2) (3) Within 10 calendar days after the end of each fiscal week

adFund.quote: An advertising and promotional obligation ("APO") in an amount set forth in your Franchise Agreement. Your APO will be up to 7% of Hardee's Gross Sales. Currently, your APO is 5.5% of Hardee's Gross Sales. (3)
adFund.note: Total APO currently 5.5% (up to 7%), divided between the Hardee's National Advertising Fund (currently 4.25%, 4.50% effective June 30, 2026), a Regional Co-op where applicable (minimum 0.5%, 0.25% effective June 30, 2026; co-op may vote increases, even above 7% total) and Local Store Marketing (the remainder, not paid to HR). Development Incentive Program: royalty and APO each reduced by 3%/2%/1% in years 1-3.

otherRecurring.name: Digital Tech Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $160 per fiscal period (4 week accounting period)

otherRecurring.name: Software Support Fee (Genius or PAR Brink) and CrunchTime
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $118 per Franchised Restaurant per fiscal period (4 week accounting period); in addition, $825 per Franchised Restaurant bi-annually (every 26 week accounting period) for back office support fee payable to CrunchTime

otherRecurring.name: Star University Access Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $18.20 per Fiscal Period (currently a 4-week accounting period)

otherRecurring.name: Lease / Sublease Administration Fee (only if leasing/subleasing from HR or affiliate, on renewal/amendment)

special: If you buy an existing restaurant from HR, the royalty may be higher, not to exceed 6% of Gross Sales, and for a Former Corporate Restaurant where HR leases the building and subleases it to you, you pay HR rent passing through all prime-lease rent and escalations (amount varies; not a % of sales).
